events.title: 레알 마드리드 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄 by defeating Brazil's 바스쿠 다 가마: 2–1. The winning goal for the Spaniards is scored by Raúl in the 83rd minute.
Brian Kidd steps down as 맨체스터 유나이티드 assistant manager to succeed 로이 호지슨 as manager of 블랙번 로버스.
블랙번 로버스 beat Charlton 1–0 in their first game under Brian Kidd at Ewood Park .
Dutch club 스파르타 로테르담 fires manager Hans van der Zee . He is replaced by Jan Everse on December 24.
Five years after leaving them from 블랙번 로버스, 데이비드 배티 returns to 리즈 유나이티드 in a £4.4 million move from 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
브라이언 매클레어 , who was among the names linked with succeeding Brian Kidd as assistant manager at 맨체스터 유나이티드, is appointed as Kidd's assistant at 블랙번 로버스.

맨체스터 유나이티드 lost 3–2 at home to 미들즈브러 – their first home defeat for nine months. United are managed by coach Jimmy Ryan , as 알렉스 퍼거슨 misses the game on compassionate grounds following the death of his sister-in-law, and United have yet to find a permanent successor to Brian Kidd as assistant manager.

The Independent reports that up to ten Premier League clubs could break away to join a European Super League if the Premier League loses its forthcoming High Court case with the Office of Fair Trading . The case will see the Office of Fair Trading bring a case against the Football League, BSkyB and the BBC in the hope of ending collective bargaining for television deals by Premier League clubs.
The key drama on Boxing Day sees defender 로니 욘센 score twice in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 3–0 home win over 노팅엄 포리스트,
French defender Didier Domi joins 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in a £4 million move from 파리 생제르맹 .

1998 draws to a close with 애스턴 빌라 still leading the Premier League, but with 첼시, 맨체스터 유나이티드, 아스널, 리즈 유나이티드 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 all posing a fairly close threat. 노팅엄 포리스트, 사우샘프턴 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 occupy the bottom three places. 선덜랜드 and 입스위치 타운 continue to lead the way in the race for a Premier League place, with the playoff zone being occupied by 버밍엄 시티, 볼턴 원더러스, 왓퍼드 and an ever-improving 브래드퍼드 시티 .
